priorityList: Cast Recklessness and Avatar on cooldown, ideally together for maximum burst.
Cast Rampage if you are near the Rage cap (100+) or if your Enrage buff is about to expire.
Cast Bladestorm while Enraged, specifically while Recklessness is active.
Cast Bloodbath (empowered Bloodthirst) as a priority generator.
Cast Rampage while Recklessness is active to maintain high Enrage uptime.
Cast Execute whenever it is available, either through Sudden Death procs or the target's health being in Execute range.
Cast Crushing Blow (empowered Raging Blow) to generate Rage and maintain pressure.
Cast Bloodthirst as a standard generator to build Rage.
Cast Rampage as your primary Rage spender if no higher priority conditions are met.
Refresh Rend if the damage-over-time effect has less than 6 seconds remaining.
Cast Raging Blow as your filler Rage generator.
Use Whirlwind only as a last resort if all other rotational abilities are on cooldown.
Use offensive trinkets and racial abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury) during your Recklessness window.
Use Charge to close the gap to your target and Pummel to interrupt enemy spellcasting.
